name: White Damar + Acacia + Bole Rubra
indication_description:
This is indicated in-
  • Diarrhoea
  • Gastric ulcer
  • Duodenal ulcer
  • Convulsions
pharmacology_description: This is a unique medicine prepared with the valuable natural ingredients, which is highly effective in the treatment of diarrhoea. It strengthens the gastrointestinal barrier and prevents gastric & intestinal ulcer. It is also very effective to remove convulsion.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) 2-3 times daily or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in therapeutic dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
